## Contribution mode

Choose one or more: teaching/synthesis · FR/EN parity/navigation · implementation/tests · controlled experiment/evaluation · critical review/correction · figures/references · build/dependencies/tooling.

## Purpose and scope

- What question, misconception, defect, or experimental hypothesis does this change address?
- Which pages, code paths, tests, configurations, or results are affected?
- Is this new, revised, planned, or verified work?

## Evidence and reproducibility

- [ ] General concepts link to canonical Wiki explanations rather than duplicating them.
- [ ] Claims, assumptions, counterexamples, limitations, and source provenance are explicit.
- [ ] Numerical/model changes include relevant tests; experiments record data provenance, splits, configuration, seed, metrics, hardware/cost, and limitations.
- [ ] French and English versions remain substantively equivalent where applicable.
- [ ] External figures/data are appropriately attributed and licensed.
- [ ] No secrets, raw datasets, model weights, or large generated outputs are committed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Python tests/lint/type checks and/or Quarto render checks were run; unavailable checks are explained.
- [ ] Rendered output and affected language version were reviewed.
- [ ] CI is not presented as proof of scientific correctness.

## Risks / follow-up

List discrepancies, unverified claims, limitations, or follow-up work. Write `None` if there are none.
